newsitem.title: USA: Penn Traffic Q4 sales $815 mln,down 14 pct.
newsitem.headline: Penn Traffic Q4 sales $815 mln,down 14 pct.

text.p: Penn Traffic Co Wednesday said revenues for the fourth quarter ended February 1, 1997 (13 weeks) were about $815 million, a drop of 14 percent from the prior year's 14-week quarter.
Revenues for the 52-week period ended February 1, 1997, were about $3.297 billion, down 6.8 percent from the 53-week period ended February 3, 1996.

Excluding the impact of 11 general merchandise stores and two former Acme stores which were closed during the fiscal year ended February 3, revenues for the 52-week period ended February 1 fell 5.6 percent from the 53-week period ended February 3, 1996.

Same-store sales fell 6.9 percent for the quarter. Same-store sales for the 52-week period ended February 1 fell 3.4 percent from the prior year. Same store sales trends are presented on a comparable week basis.

Sales during the fourth quarter were affected by significantly milder weather in the company's markets in comparison with last year, planned lower promotional activity by the company and disruption associated with the introduction of the new dry grocery program, Penn Traffic said.
It expects to report its full fourth quarter financial results in mid-March.
